# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.

And the read at 880-940 confirms: no spills, subagents, waiting, jobs, agentMode, misuseBreaker, streamThinking.

So `withCustomProviders` DROPS spills, subagents, waiting, jobs, agentMode, misuseBreaker, streamThinking! And saveCliConfig uses withCustomProviders internally (`_mergeWithOnDisk` returns `config.withCustomProviders(...)`). So even a CORRECT caller carrying spills would lose them through saveCliConfig's merge step! This is another root-cause piece — the comment says "keep this field list in sync with the constructor when a section is added" and it drifted.

The robust fix per the ticket: "carry every parsed field through persistConfig (use saved as the base, e.g. a copyWith)". For CliConfig, implementing a proper `copyWith` would replace `withCustomProviders` entirely. copyWith should have an optional parameter per field, null = keep. But careful: several fields are nullable where null is meaningful (e.g., modelRoles: null = absent). A copyWith(null) can't distinguish "keep" vs "clear". For our use (persistConfig), we only ever SET fields to non-null or to values derived from saved, so null = keep works... but wait: `customProviders: cli.config.customProviders?.entries ?? saved.customProviders` — always a list. `models: cli.config.modelsConfig ?? saved.models` — could be null if both null (fine, keep null). `mcp: cli.config.mcpConfig?.config ?? saved.mcp` — could be null (fine).

But for generality and to avoid the drift problem entirely, copyWith's "null = keep" semantics with a sentinel-based design is complex in Dart. The established codebase pattern (withCustomProviders) just passes all fields explicitly — the problem is drift. A full `copyWith` with ALL fields as optional named params, null = keep, is the standard approach; the nullable-clear problem exists but is acceptable (documented). Since the constructor has defaults for everything, copyWith can't use `this.x` pattern directly... it can: `CliConfig copyWith({String? providerKind, ...}) => CliConfig(providerKind: providerKind ?? this.providerKind, ...)`. For non-nullable fields with defaults this works perfectly. For nullable fields (modelRoles, ttsr, spills, etc.), null means keep — meaning you can never set them to null via copyWith. That's acceptable and standard.

Now for saveCliConfig's internal merge — it should use copyWith(customProviders: merged) instead of withCustomProviders, which fixes the drift there too (spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking survive the merge). Keep `withCustomProviders` for compatibility (it's public API — check usages) but fix its missing fields OR deprecate it. Let me check usages of withCustomProviders.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

So `withCustomProviders` DROPS spills, subagents, waiting, jobs, agentMode, misuseBreaker, streamThinking! And saveCliConfig uses withCustomProviders internally (`_mergeWithOnDisk` returns `config.withCustomProviders(...)`). So even a CORRECT caller carrying spills would lose them through saveCliConfig's merge step! This is another root-cause piece — the comment says "keep this field list in sync with the constructor when a section is added" and it drifted.

The robust fix per the ticket: "carry every parsed field through persistConfig (use saved as the base, e.g. a copyWith)". For CliConfig, implementing a proper `copyWith` would replace `withCustomProviders` entirely. copyWith should have an optional parameter per field, null = keep. But careful: several fields are nullable where null is meaningful (e.g., modelRoles: null = absent). A copyWith(null) can't distinguish "keep" vs "clear". For our use (persistConfig), we only ever SET fields to non-null or to values derived from saved, so null = keep works... but wait: `customProviders: cli.config.customProviders?.entries ?? saved.customProviders` — always a list. `models: cli.config.modelsConfig ?? saved.models` — could be null if both null (fine, keep null). `mcp: cli.config.mcpConfig?.config ?? saved.mcp` — could be null (fine).

But for generality and to avoid the drift problem entirely, copyWith's "null = keep" semantics with a sentinel-based design is complex in Dart. The established codebase pattern (withCustomProviders) just passes all fields explicitly — the problem is drift. A full `copyWith` with ALL fields as optional named params, null = keep, is the standard approach; the nullable-clear problem exists but is acceptable (documented). Since the constructor has defaults for everything, copyWith can't use `this.x` pattern directly... it can: `CliConfig copyWith({String? providerKind, ...}) => CliConfig(providerKind: providerKind ?? this.providerKind, ...)`. For non-nullable fields with defaults this works perfectly. For nullable fields (modelRoles, ttsr, spills, etc.), null means keep — meaning you can never set them to null via copyWith. That's acceptable and standard.

Now for saveCliConfig's internal merge — it should use copyWith(customProviders: merged) instead of withCustomProviders, which fixes the drift there too (spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking survive the merge). # gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Starting `fa` rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently drops the user's `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` (and `waiting`/`power.hold`/`auto_update`) sections.

**Root cause** (three cooperating defects):

1. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` `persistConfig` (~1553-1625) builds a **new** `CliConfig(...)` carrying only ~24 of the ~40 parsed fields. It never passes `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `contextWindowCap`/`stuckTool`/`agentLoadMode`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`, `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`tuiClassic`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `powerHold`, `skillsLiveRediscovery`, `links`, `compaction*`, `streamThinking`, `autoUpdate` — so those fields reset to constructor defaults in the object being saved.
2. `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~901-934) — the copy helper `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write step uses — drifted the same way: it also drops `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `agentMode`, `misuseBreaker`, `streamThinking`. Even a correct caller would lose those through the merge.
3. The disk-preservation backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (`cli_config.dart` ~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, so sections dropped by (1)/(2) are not re-attached from disk either. Additionally `CliConfig.toYaml()` never renders `spills:` (SpillsConfig has no renderer), and `persistConfig()` is invoked unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so every launch performs the lossy rewrite even when nothing changed.

**Impact**: any `fa` boot (or `/model`, `/provider`, mode/approval/tools/skills change — every `persistConfig` caller) permanently deletes the listed user sections from the global config. First reported on 1.0.547, verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d.

**Fix approach**:

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`: add a complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); reimplement `withCustomProviders` as `copyWith(customProviders: entries)` so the copy helper can never drift again; render `spills:` in `toYaml()` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and render `agent.misuseBreaker: false` so the raw `agent:` block carries every parsed key; extend `_diskPreservedSections` with `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`; skip the temp-file+rename in `saveCliConfig` when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text (no write at boot when nothing changed).
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every parsed field rides along from `saved` by construction, so the save can no longer drop a section; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (per-folder model state) unchanged.

**Previous attempt**: none (first fix).

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Starting `fa` rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently drops the user's `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` (and `waiting`/`power.hold`/`auto_update`) sections.

**Root cause** (three cooperating defects):

1. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` `persistConfig` (~1553-1625) builds a **new** `CliConfig(...)` carrying only ~24 of the ~40 parsed fields. It never passes `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `contextWindowCap`/`stuckTool`/`agentLoadMode`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`, `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`tuiClassic`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `powerHold`, `skillsLiveRediscovery`, `links`, `compaction*`, `streamThinking`, `autoUpdate` — so those fields reset to constructor defaults in the object being saved.
2. `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~901-934) — the copy helper `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write step uses — drifted the same way: it also drops `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `agentMode`, `misuseBreaker`, `streamThinking`. Even a correct caller would lose those through the merge.
3. The disk-preservation backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (`cli_config.dart` ~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, so sections dropped by (1)/(2) are not re-attached from disk either. Additionally `CliConfig.toYaml()` never renders `spills:` (SpillsConfig has no renderer), and `persistConfig()` is invoked unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so every launch performs the lossy rewrite even when nothing changed.

**Impact**: any `fa` boot (or `/model`, `/provider`, mode/approval/tools/skills change — every `persistConfig` caller) permanently deletes the listed user sections from the global config. First reported on 1.0.547, verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d.

**Fix approach**:

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`: add a complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); reimplement `withCustomProviders` as `copyWith(customProviders: entries)` so the copy helper can never drift again; render `spills:` in `toYaml()` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and render `agent.misuseBreaker: false` so the raw `agent:` block carries every parsed key; extend `_diskPreservedSections` with `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`; skip the temp-file+rename in `saveCliConfig` when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text (no write at boot when nothing changed).
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every parsed field rides along from `saved` by construction, so the save can no longer drop a section; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (per-folder model state) unchanged.

**Previous attempt**: none (first fix).
"}

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Starting `fa` rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently drops the user's `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` (and `waiting`/`power.hold`/`auto_update`) sections.

**Root cause** (three cooperating defects):

1. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` `persistConfig` (~1553-1625) builds a **new** `CliConfig(...)` carrying only ~24 of the ~40 parsed fields. It never passes `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `contextWindowCap`/`stuckTool`/`agentLoadMode`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`, `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`tuiClassic`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `powerHold`, `skillsLiveRediscovery`, `links`, `compaction*`, `streamThinking`, `autoUpdate` — so those fields reset to constructor defaults in the object being saved.
2. `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~901-934) — the copy helper `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write step uses — drifted the same way: it also drops `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `agentMode`, `misuseBreaker`, `streamThinking`. Even a correct caller would lose those through the merge.
3. The disk-preservation backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (`cli_config.dart` ~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, so sections dropped by (1)/(2) are not re-attached from disk either. Additionally `CliConfig.toYaml()` never renders `spills:` (SpillsConfig has no renderer), and `persistConfig()` is invoked unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so every launch performs the lossy rewrite even when nothing changed.

**Impact**: any `fa` boot (or `/model`, `/provider`, mode/approval/tools/skills change — every `persistConfig` caller) permanently deletes the listed user sections from the global config. First reported on 1.0.547, verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d.

**Fix approach**:

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`: add a complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); reimplement `withCustomProviders` as `copyWith(customProviders: entries)` so the copy helper can never drift again; render `spills:` in `toYaml()` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and render `agent.misuseBreaker: false` so the raw `agent:` block carries every parsed key; extend `_diskPreservedSections` with `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`; skip the temp-file+rename in `saveCliConfig` when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text (no write at boot when nothing changed).
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every parsed field rides along from `saved` by construction, so the save can no longer drop a section; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (per-folder model state) unchanged.

**Previous attempt**: none (first fix).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Starting `fa` rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently drops the user's `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` (and `waiting`/`power.hold`/`auto_update`) sections.

**Root cause** (three cooperating defects):

1. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` `persistConfig` (~1553-1625) builds a **new** `CliConfig(...)` carrying only ~24 of the ~40 parsed fields. It never passes `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `contextWindowCap`/`stuckTool`/`agentLoadMode`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`, `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`tuiClassic`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `powerHold`, `skillsLiveRediscovery`, `links`, `compaction*`, `streamThinking`, `autoUpdate` — so those fields reset to constructor defaults in the object being saved.
2. `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~901-934) — the copy helper `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write step uses — drifted the same way: it also drops `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `agentMode`, `misuseBreaker`, `streamThinking`. Even a correct caller would lose those through the merge.
3. The disk-preservation backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (`cli_config.dart` ~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, so sections dropped by (1)/(2) are not re-attached from disk either. Additionally `CliConfig.toYaml()` never renders `spills:` (SpillsConfig has no renderer), and `persistConfig()` is invoked unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so every launch performs the lossy rewrite even when nothing changed.

**Impact**: any `fa` boot (or `/model`, `/provider`, mode/approval/tools/skills change — every `persistConfig` caller) permanently deletes the listed user sections from the global config. First reported on 1.0.547, verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d.

**Fix approach**:

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`: add a complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); reimplement `withCustomProviders` as `copyWith(customProviders: entries)` so the copy helper can never drift again; render `spills:` in `toYaml()` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and render `agent.misuseBreaker: false` so the raw `agent:` block carries every parsed key; extend `_diskPreservedSections` with `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`; skip the temp-file+rename in `saveCliConfig` when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text (no write at boot when nothing changed).
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every parsed field rides along from `saved` by construction, so the save can no longer drop a section; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (per-folder model state) unchanged.

**Previous attempt**: none (first fix).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Starting `fa` rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently drops the user's `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` (and `waiting`/`power.hold`/`auto_update`) sections.

**Root cause** (three cooperating defects):

1. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` `persistConfig` (~1553-1625) builds a **new** `CliConfig(...)` carrying only ~24 of the ~40 parsed fields. It never passes `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `contextWindowCap`/`stuckTool`/`agentLoadMode`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`, `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`tuiClassic`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `powerHold`, `skillsLiveRediscovery`, `links`, `compaction*`, `streamThinking`, `autoUpdate` — so those fields reset to constructor defaults in the object being saved.
2. `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~901-934) — the copy helper `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write step uses — drifted the same way: it also drops `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `agentMode`, `misuseBreaker`, `streamThinking`. Even a correct caller would lose those through the merge.
3. The disk-preservation backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (`cli_config.dart` ~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, so sections dropped by (1)/(2) are not re-attached from disk either. Additionally `CliConfig.toYaml()` never renders `spills:` (SpillsConfig has no renderer), and `persistConfig()` is invoked unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so every launch performs the lossy rewrite even when nothing changed.

**Impact**: any `fa` boot (or `/model`, `/provider`, mode/approval/tools/skills change — every `persistConfig` caller) permanently deletes the listed user sections from the global config. First reported on 1.0.547, verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d.

**Fix approach**:

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`: add a complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); reimplement `withCustomProviders` as `copyWith(customProviders: entries)` so the copy helper can never drift again; render `spills:` in `toYaml()` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and render `agent.misuseBreaker: false` so the raw `agent:` block carries every parsed key; extend `_diskPreservedSections` with `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`; skip the temp-file+rename in `saveCliConfig` when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text (no write at boot when nothing changed).
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every parsed field rides along from `saved` by construction, so the save can no longer drop a section; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (per-folder model state) unchanged.

**Previous attempt**: none (first fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Starting `fa` rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently drops the user's `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` (and `waiting`/`power.hold`/`auto_update`) sections.

**Root cause** (three cooperating defects):

1. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` `persistConfig` (~1553-1625) builds a **new** `CliConfig(...)` carrying only ~24 of the ~40 parsed fields. It never passes `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `contextWindowCap`/`stuckTool`/`agentLoadMode`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`, `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`tuiClassic`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `powerHold`, `skillsLiveRediscovery`, `links`, `compaction*`, `streamThinking`, `autoUpdate` — so those fields reset to constructor defaults in the object being saved.
2. `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~901-934) — the copy helper `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write step uses — drifted the same way: it also drops `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `agentMode`, `misuseBreaker`, `streamThinking`. Even a correct caller would lose those through the merge.
3. The disk-preservation backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (`cli_config.dart` ~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, so sections dropped by (1)/(2) are not re-attached from disk either. Additionally `CliConfig.toYaml()` never renders `spills:` (SpillsConfig has no renderer), and `persistConfig()` is invoked unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so every launch performs the lossy rewrite even when nothing changed.

**Impact**: any `fa` boot (or `/model`, `/provider`, mode/approval/tools/skills change — every `persistConfig` caller) permanently deletes the listed user sections from the global config. First reported on 1.0.547, verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d.

**Fix approach**:

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`: add a complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); reimplement `withCustomProviders` as `copyWith(customProviders: entries)` so the copy helper can never drift again; render `spills:` in `toYaml()` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and render `agent.misuseBreaker: false` so the raw `agent:` block carries every parsed key; extend `_diskPreservedSections` with `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`; skip the temp-file+rename in `saveCliConfig` when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text (no write at boot when nothing changed).
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every parsed field rides along from `saved` by construction, so the save can no longer drop a section; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (per-folder model state) unchanged.

**Previous attempt**: none (first fix).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Starting `fa` rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently drops the user's `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` (and `waiting`/`power.hold`/`auto_update`) sections.

**Root cause** (three cooperating defects):

1. `bin/fah_runapp.dart` `persistConfig` (~1553-1625) builds a **new** `CliConfig(...)` carrying only ~24 of the ~40 parsed fields. It never passes `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `contextWindowCap`/`stuckTool`/`agentLoadMode`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`, `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`tuiClassic`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `powerHold`, `skillsLiveRediscovery`, `links`, `compaction*`, `streamThinking`, `autoUpdate` — so those fields reset to constructor defaults in the object being saved.
2. `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~901-934) — the copy helper `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write step uses — drifted the same way: it also drops `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `agentMode`, `misuseBreaker`, `streamThinking`. Even a correct caller would lose those through the merge.
3. The disk-preservation backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (`cli_config.dart` ~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, so sections dropped by (1)/(2) are not re-attached from disk either. Additionally `CliConfig.toYaml()` never renders `spills:` (SpillsConfig has no renderer), and `persistConfig()` is invoked unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so every launch performs the lossy rewrite even when nothing changed.

**Impact**: any `fa` boot (or `/model`, `/provider`, mode/approval/tools/skills change — every `persistConfig` caller) permanently deletes the listed user sections from the global config. First reported on 1.0.547, verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d.

**Fix approach**:

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`: add a complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); reimplement `withCustomProviders` as `copyWith(customProviders: entries)` so the copy helper can never drift again; render `spills:` in `toYaml()` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and render `agent.misuseBreaker: false` so the raw `agent:` block carries every parsed key; extend `_diskPreservedSections` with `spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`; skip the temp-file+rename in `saveCliConfig` when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text (no write at boot when nothing changed).
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every parsed field rides along from `saved` by construction, so the save can no longer drop a section; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (per-folder model state) unchanged.

**Previous attempt**: none (first fix).
"}
