blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 12 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

The gh-1572 bug fix is complete. Final summary:

## Root cause (3 cooperating leaks)
1. **`persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`)** built a fresh `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields — `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update` reset to defaults on every boot (the save runs unconditionally at boot).
2. **`CliConfig.withCustomProviders`** (the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write) had drifted the same way — even a correct caller lost `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`.
3. **`_diskPreservedSections`** didn't list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk; `toYaml()` couldn't render `spills:` at all.

## Fix
- **`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`**: complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` → `copyWith` delegation (drift-proof); `toYaml` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) + `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; backstop extended to every known top-level key (incl. `power`, `auto_update`); `saveCliConfig` skips the write when output is byte-identical to disk — **no write at boot when nothing changed**.
- **`bin/fah_runapp.dart`**: `persistConfig` = `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` — every section rides along by construction; provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (per-launch flags never change saved defaults); `compaction:` carries the loaded global value only, never the session/project pick.

## Verification
- **TDD**: 6 new regression tests in `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — all failed before the fix (verified RED), all pass after.
- **E2E** with the ticket's exact repro (isolated HOME): every user section survives boot, `spills:` renders; second boot performs no write (mtime unchanged).
- **Suites**: 178 tests green in affected suites; full suite ~4000 groups green — all 19 local failures proven pre-existing environmental noise (14 runner-env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` hijacks that pass with vars unset and fail identically on base; 5 Chrome/D-Bus `browser_ext` infra failures where base fails the identical 5).

## Outputs
`outputs/rca.md` + `outputs/response.md` written; CHANGELOG entry added; analyzer + formatter clean; working tree committed on `ai/gh-1572`.

blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 12 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

1. `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) built a **fresh** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields — `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update` reset to defaults in every save, and the save runs unconditionally at boot.
2. `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted too (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`).
3. The `_diskPreservedSections` backstop didn't list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk; `toYaml` couldn't render `spills:` at all.

## Fix
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`: complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it (drift-proof); `toYaml` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; backstop extended to every known top-level key (+`power`, +`auto_update`); `saveCliConfig` skips the write when output is byte-identical to disk (no write at boot when nothing changed).
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` = `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` — every section rides along by construction; provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (flags never change saved defaults); `compaction:` carries the loaded global value only, never the session/project pick.

## Verification (TDD)
- 6 new regression tests (`test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart`): all 6 RED (fail) before the fix, all GREEN after — round-trip, boot-shaped overlay save, spills render/omit, backstop, no-rewrite-on-unchanged (mtime-pinned).
- E2E with the ticket's exact repro (isolated HOME): every user section survives boot, `spills:` now renders; second boot makes NO write (mtime unchanged).
- Affected suites: 178 tests green; full suite ~4000 groups green. The 19 local full-run failures are proven pre-existing environmental noise: 14 are `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` runner-env hijacks (pass with vars unset; fail identically on base commit — Dart `Process.run` merges env over inherited), 5 are Chrome/D-Bus browser_ext infra failures (base fails the identical 5).

## Outputs
- `outputs/rca.md`, `outputs/response.md` (PR description) written; no blocked/already-fixed conditions. Working tree clean (auto-save commits on `ai/gh-1572`), analyzer + formatter clean, CHANGELOG entry added under `## Unreleased`."}

The gh-1572 bug fix is complete. Final summary:

## Root cause (3 cooperating leaks)
1. **`persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`)** built a fresh `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields — `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update` reset to defaults on every boot (the save runs unconditionally at boot).
2. **`CliConfig.withCustomProviders`** (the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write) had drifted the same way — even a correct caller lost `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`.
3. **`_diskPreservedSections`** didn't list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk; `toYaml()` couldn't render `spills:` at all.

## Fix
- **`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`**: complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` → `copyWith` delegation (drift-proof); `toYaml` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) + `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; backstop extended to every known top-level key (incl. `power`, `auto_update`); `saveCliConfig` skips the write when output is byte-identical to disk — **no write at boot when nothing changed**.
- **`bin/fah_runapp.dart`**: `persistConfig` = `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` — every section rides along by construction; provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (per-launch flags never change saved defaults); `compaction:` carries the loaded global value only, never the session/project pick.

## Verification
- **TDD**: 6 new regression tests in `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — all failed before the fix (verified RED), all pass after.
- **E2E** with the ticket's exact repro (isolated HOME): every user section survives boot, `spills:` renders; second boot performs no write (mtime unchanged).
- **Suites**: 178 tests green in affected suites; full suite ~4000 groups green — all 19 local failures proven pre-existing environmental noise (14 runner-env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` hijacks that pass with vars unset and fail identically on base; 5 Chrome/D-Bus `browser_ext` infra failures where base fails the identical 5).

## Outputs
`outputs/rca.md` + `outputs/response.md` written; CHANGELOG entry added; analyzer + formatter clean; working tree committed on `ai/gh-1572`.

blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 12 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

3. **`_diskPreservedSections`** didn't list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk; `toYaml()` couldn't render `spills:` at all.

- **`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`**: complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` → `copyWith` delegation (drift-proof); `toYaml` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) + `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; backstop extended to every known top-level key (incl. `power`, `auto_update`); `saveCliConfig` skips the write when output is byte-identical to disk — **no write at boot when nothing changed**.
- **`bin/fah_runapp.dart`**: `persistConfig` = `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` — every section rides along by construction; provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (per-launch flags never change saved defaults); `compaction:` carries the loaded global value only, never the session/project pick.

## Verification

blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 12 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 12 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

Everything is complete. One small inaccuracy to fix: "12 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked" — the counts: headless_log_file 4 + yolo_rm 2 + headless_tools_flag 2 + backend_mode 5 + header_badge 1 = 14, not 12. Let me fix that number. 4+2+2+5+1 = 14. And 14 + 5 browser = 19. ✓

blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 12 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

Everything is complete. One small inaccuracy to fix: "12 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked" — the counts: headless_log_file 4 + yolo_rm 2 + headless_tools_flag 2 + backend_mode 5 + header_badge 1 = 14, not 12. Let me fix that number. 4+2+2+5+1 = 14. And 14 + 5 browser = 19. ✓
